verdict.rationale: Deepgram is an API-first service with a documented `dg` CLI. The CLI states its exit codes exist so 'scripts and CI steps can branch on them', offers switchable output formats via -o/--output, and auto-detects AI agent environments such as Claude Code and Codex to adjust its behavior. This sits alongside REST/WebSocket endpoints, multi-language SDKs and short-lived JWT generation, all of which support non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI/CI usage, and explicit docs on non-interactive auth setup (e.g., env-var API keys in CI).
